boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named Lafayette spaces for studying, gathering, campus programs, recreation, and academic support, verified through current College sources.

cards.title: Settle Into Farinon Between Commitments
cards.subtitle: A student center with study space, services, dining, and club offices
cards.notes: Use the open seating for work between commitments, then find club offices, campus services, and dining elsewhere in the building.
cards.short_summary: A flexible student-center base for studying, meeting, and handling everyday campus errands.
cards.evidence_claim: Lafayette identified Farinon College Center as a finals study space open from 7 a.m. to 1 a.m.; the campus map lists dining, club offices, student services, and gathering rooms inside.
cards.source_title: Finals 2026: Study spaces and study breaks
cards.access_notes: The cited 7 a.m.–1 a.m. schedule applied during the Spring 2026 finals period; verify regular building hours before visiting.

cards.title: Match the Task to Skillman’s Floors
cards.subtitle: Library seating, collections, archives, gallery space, and group-study options
cards.notes: Choose a study area that fits the task, keep belongings with you, and check the library schedule before planning an overnight finals session.
cards.short_summary: The main library combines focused work areas with group spaces and specialized collections.
cards.evidence_claim: Lafayette designated Skillman Library as a Spring 2026 finals study space, and the campus map identifies the Lass Gallery, Simon Special Collections Room, and College Archives there.
cards.source_title: Finals 2026: Study spaces and study breaks
cards.access_notes: The cited 7:30 a.m.–2 a.m. schedule applied during Spring 2026 finals. Overnight finals access requires a current Lafayette ID and may restrict some rooms.

cards.title: Use Soles for a Residence-Hall Study Shift
cards.subtitle: A designated finals study lounge inside Soles Hall
cards.notes: Bring what you need for a quiet work block and follow residence-hall access rules; confirm availability outside the published finals period.
cards.short_summary: A residence-hall lounge explicitly assigned for round-the-clock finals studying.
cards.evidence_claim: Lafayette’s Spring 2026 finals guidance named Soles Hall Study Lounge as one of the residence-hall study spaces available 24 hours.
cards.source_title: Finals 2026: Study spaces and study breaks
cards.access_notes: The 24-hour designation applied during Spring 2026 finals. Residence-hall entry may be limited to authorized students and guests.

cards.title: Shift Group Work to Keefe Commons
cards.subtitle: A named residence-hall commons used for finals study
cards.notes: Use the commons for a late study block while observing quiet-hour expectations and any residence-hall guest or card-access requirements.
cards.short_summary: A residential commons formally opened as a 24-hour study location during finals.
cards.evidence_claim: Lafayette’s Spring 2026 finals guidance identified Keefe Commons as a 24-hour residence-hall study space.
cards.source_title: Finals 2026: Study spaces and study breaks
cards.access_notes: The 24-hour study-space designation applied during Spring 2026 finals. Residence-hall access restrictions may apply.

cards.title: Use Marquis Between Meal Rushes
cards.subtitle: A dining hall temporarily designated for finals studying
cards.notes: Plan a daytime work session around dining operations, and confirm whether the room is currently available for studying before settling in.
cards.short_summary: A dining room that Lafayette also activates as scheduled study space during finals.
cards.evidence_claim: Lafayette listed Marquis Dining Hall as a Spring 2026 finals study space, scheduled from 7 a.m. to 8 p.m. beginning May 11.
cards.source_title: Finals 2026: Study spaces and study breaks
cards.access_notes: The cited study schedule was specific to Spring 2026 finals; ordinary access follows current dining and campus schedules.

cards.title: Read and Write in Kirby Library
cards.subtitle: A quiet library inside Kirby Hall of Civil Rights
cards.notes: Try Kirby for reading or concentrated writing, but consult current library access information before depending on the space for a long session.
cards.short_summary: A distinctive wood-paneled academic library used by students for quiet study.
cards.evidence_claim: A Lafayette student described Kirby Library as a quiet study setting, and the current College campus map places it in Kirby Hall of Civil Rights.
cards.source_title: Struggling to find a study spot? Seven options to try this finals season
cards.access_notes: Library hours and building access may vary by academic calendar and campus affiliation; check current library information.

cards.entity_name: Dyer Center for Innovation and Entrepreneurship
cards.title: Work Near the Dyer Center’s Windows
cards.subtitle: An innovation center inside Rockwell Integrated Sciences Center
cards.notes: Use the surrounding RISC setting for project work, and confirm whether Dyer Center rooms or programs require membership or reservations.
cards.short_summary: An innovation-focused RISC destination that a student highlighted as a comfortable work setting.
cards.evidence_claim: A Lafayette student identified the Dyer Center in RISC as a preferred study setting; the College campus map lists the Dyer Center for Innovation in Rockwell Integrated Sciences Center.
cards.source_title: Struggling to find a study spot? Seven options to try this finals season
cards.access_notes: Some Dyer Center spaces, programs, or amenities may be limited to participants; observe posted access and reservation rules.

cards.title: Meet by the Leopard’s Lair Fireplace
cards.subtitle: A student lounge in Farinon College Center’s basement
cards.notes: Use the lounge for a casual conversation or a break between tasks, and leave organized programs and reserved areas available to their hosts.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated Farinon student lounge centered on informal gathering rather than dining.
cards.evidence_claim: Lafayette Magazine documented Leopard’s Lair as a student lounge with a fireplace in the basement of Farinon College Center.
cards.access_notes: Located inside Farinon College Center; access follows current building hours and any posted event or reservation restrictions.

cards.title: Take the Work Session Outdoors on the Quad
cards.subtitle: Central lawn with chairs, swings, programs, and room to pause
cards.notes: Bring portable work or meet a friend outdoors, then check the College calendar and posted signs before using space occupied by a campus program.
cards.short_summary: The central outdoor commons supports both scheduled campus activity and informal downtime.
cards.evidence_claim: Lafayette’s campus map describes the Quad as an open space with Adirondack chairs and swings that hosts campus programs and sunny-day relaxation.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor access is weather-dependent, and scheduled College programs may temporarily occupy portions of the Quad.

cards.title: Reset Between Classes at Kirby Sports Center
cards.subtitle: Campus recreation complex with courts, pools, track, fitness areas, and climbing wall
cards.notes: Choose an activity that fits your break, bring the required gear, and check current eligibility, hours, reservations, and facility-specific rules first.
cards.short_summary: A multi-level recreation hub for exercise, pickup play, swimming, and climbing.
cards.evidence_claim: Lafayette’s campus map lists Kirby Sports Center facilities including a fitness center, climbing wall, gymnasiums, exercise rooms, indoor track, pools, courts, and game room.
cards.access_notes: Facility access, activity eligibility, reservations, and operating hours vary; consult current Recreation Services information before visiting.
